  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, APRIL 08, 2026 AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council with valuable
information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically, adjourned
meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City
Clerk via email at CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626) 300-0705 48 hours prior to the
meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the meeting will
proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will do it’s best to resolve
any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:
Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00 p.m. the day before
the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. will be distributed to City Council during the
meeting. Any comments received after 3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not
provided to City Council at the meeting.

 Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module during the
meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted after the in-person comments. Once the Mayor calls
for Zoom comments, they will be read or summarized in the order received, then made part of the public
record for the meeting. No further Zoom comments will be read after the conclusion of public comment for
that item.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chang, Council Member Chou, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Vice
Mayor Lo and Mayor Chou

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to
place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the City Manager to inform the City Council and the public of any
upcoming events or matters of interest to the community.

  PRESENTATION

  PRESENTATION OF PROCLAMATION FOR NATIONAL LIBRARY WEEK

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  1.  PUBLIC HEARING ON CITY VACANCIES AND RECRUITMENT AND
  RETENTION EFFORTS (ASSEMBLY BILL 2561/GOVERNMENT CODE

AGENDA – APRIL 08, 2026  PAGE 2 of 5
   SECTION 3502.3)

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council to receive and file the report. If the
  City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “ I move to receive and file this year’s report as required by Government Code
  Section 3502.3.”

  NEW BUSINESS

 2.  APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION NO. R-26-06 TO RE-ESTABLISH FISCAL
  YEAR 2026-27 PUBLIC SAFETY SPECIAL TAX LEVIES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve a 5% increase in
  the public safety parcel tax levy. If the City Council concurs with staff’s
  recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve Resolution No. R-26-06 establishing the Public Safety Special Tax
  Levies for Fiscal Year 2026-27.”

 3.  DIRECTION ON SEWER SERVICE CHARGE FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026–27

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council provide direction on the
  proposed Sewer Service Charge for FY 2026-27, including consideration of a 3%
  increase to account for inflation. Following Council direction, staff will return with a
  resolution for formal consideration at a public hearing in May.

  CONSENT CALENDAR

 4.  ACCEPTANCE OF $13,000 DONATION FROM THE SAN MARINO PUBLIC
  LIBRARY FOUNDATION

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council accept the $13,000 donation from
  the San Marino Public Library Foundation, amend the City’s Restricted Donations
  Fund Account #281-91-3601-0000 (Adult Materials Donations - Other) by $13,000,
  amend the City’s Restricted Donations Fund Account #281-91-4150-0000 (Adult
  Other Contract Services) by $3,000, amend the City’s Restricted Donations Fund
  Account #281-91-4370-0000 (Adult Materials – Other) by $5,000, and amend the
  City’s Restricted Donations Fund Account #281-91-4376-0000 (Adult Materials and
  Supplies) by $5,000. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an
  appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to accept the $13,000 donation from the San Marino Public Library
  Foundation, amend the City’s Restricted Donations Fund Account #281-91-3601-
  0000 (Adult Materials Donations - Other) by $13,000, amend the City’s Restricted
  Donations Fund Account #281-91-4150-0000 (Adult Other Contract Services) by
  $3,000, amend the City’s Restricted Donations Fund Account #281-91-4370-0000

AGENDA – APRIL 08, 2026  PAGE 3 of 5
   (Adult Materials – Other) by $5,000, and amend the City’s Restricted Donations Fund
  Account #281-91-4376-0000 (Adult Materials and Supplies) by $5,000.”

 5.  RECOMMENDATION FOR CITY COUNCIL CONCURRENCE ON THE CITY
  MANAGER’S SELECTION FOR DIRECTOR OF COMMUNITY SERVICES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council concur with the City Manager’s
  selection. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate
  motion would be:

  “I move that the City Council concur with the City Manager’s hiring of Eduardo
  Covarrubias as Director of Community Services.”

 6.  CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE MONTH OF FEBRUARY
  2026

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file this report. If the
  City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Cash and Investment Report for the Month of February
  2026.”

 7.  RECEIVE AND FILE MONTHLY DISBURSEMENTS REPORT FOR MARCH
  2026

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of March 2026. If the City Council concurs with
  staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Monthly Disbursements Report for the month of March
  2026.”

 8.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the March 2026 Minutes. If
  the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would
  be:

  “I move to approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of March 11, 2026, and the
  Adjourned Regular Meeting of March 27, 2026.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.
